speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To begin my assessment, have you noticed any changes in the color, odor, or amount of your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your symptoms persisted after the sinusitis treatment, have you noticed any visible blood in your urine or any burning sensation when you urinate? Also, how high has your fever gone?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis with culture and microscopy.
REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential and CRP.
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis secondary to amoxicillin/cephalexin allergy, with concurrent drug-induced rash.
